cohort: The study included 29,886 pregnant women and 30,051 infants from birth records in the Nantong area, China, between January 2020 and June 2021, with 29,447 singleton infants used for growth analysis.
finding: ART singleton infants demonstrated a greater likelihood of experiencing rapid growth in both length and weight during the first year of life, despite being at higher risk of SGA, and achieved growth trajectories comparable to natural pregnancy singleton infants.
mod_finding: ART infants had higher rates of cesarean section (57.7% vs. 49.1%) compared to natural pregnancy infants.
birth_weight: Included in subgroup analyses; ART infants were at a higher risk for SGA.
gest_age: Included in analysis; ART infants had higher rates of preterm birth.
